subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this flatter card-based iPhone Control tab direction on top of the current native SwiftUI List design, or keep the current native-list direction?
rationale: The PR is a user-visible default iOS design change, current main has moved the same surface toward native SwiftUI structure, and the linked feature issue is already marked as needing maintainer product/design review.

options.title: Preserve Native List Direction
options.body: Keep current main's native-list Control direction and close or narrow the card redesign unless a maintainer explicitly sponsors it.

options.title: Sponsor Card Redesign
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase over current main, preserve newer iOS fixes, replace bare fonts with OpenClawType, and add before/after simulator proof before design review.

options.title: Request A Narrow Hybrid
options.body: Limit any follow-up to a small iPhone-only hierarchy or row treatment change that fits the native SwiftUI structure already on main.

recommendation.title: Preserve Native List Direction
recommendation.body: Keep current main's native-list Control direction and close or narrow the card redesign unless a maintainer explicitly sponsors it.

likelyOwner.reason: This person carried the most recent merged visual hierarchy work that overlaps the product/design direction question.
